rules: Always maintain an index file (.agy/index.json) containing summaries of all saved memories and progress.
Save detailed full memory records inside .agy/memories/ files and register them in .agy/index.json.
When starting a session or reviewing memory, reading .agy/index.json is sufficient. Only read detailed memory files as needed based on user request or context.
Ensure Graphify query compatibility guidelines are respected.
Every React syllabus topic documented must include: (1) Concept & Under-the-Hood Mechanics, (2) Real-World Scenario, (3) Production-Grade Code Example, (4) Senior Engineer Edge Cases & Pitfalls.
